title: Munda languages map.svg
description_as_catalogued: Map of the various Munda languages using the traditional North Munda / South Munda classification; the file description states that mapped locations are taluka-level areas with more than 10,000 speakers.
source_basis_note: Commons states that the map is own work based on a derivative map and user-contributed compilation. The map itself is not an official Census product and is not treated as primary demographic evidence.

rights_and_access.reuse_boundary: File-level reuse may follow the stated Commons licence, but MLHKP does not infer community validation, authoritative linguistic boundaries, census accuracy, speaker identity, or permission to republish any third-party material beyond the file licence.

evidence_boundary: Only source identity, file metadata, stated description, creation date and file-level licence are verified. No language-distribution value, taluka classification, population number, cultural claim or present-day community boundary is promoted from this map without primary-source reconciliation.
dedupe_policy: Before assigning a permanent SRC-MMSC identifier, compare exact Commons filename, canonical URL, creator/date and any source map relationship against all 87 web leads and existing map/media records.
